schema:name: Skilled Laborers Manual Quality Sorting, Sumatra, Indonesia
schema:description: This image shows skilled laborers visually inspecting and sorting dry coffee beans to remove impurities. Hacienda La Minita serves as Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, sourcing specialty coffee from countries such as Ethiopia. Coffee in Ethiopia is grown largely by smallholder farmers and processed at local cooperatives and washing stations.
